name: case_vehicle_financing_large
problem_description: 5 claims in the reference. 5 contexts directly support each claim, 1 context contradicts a claim (insurance), 4 contexts are pure noise (off-topic). Interleaved order (relevant/noise) to test Context Precision's sensitivity to ranking.
user_input: What are the conditions for vehicle financing at this bank?
reference: Vehicle financing has a term of up to 60 months. The interest rate is 1.2% per month. A minimum down payment of 20% of the vehicle's value is required. Vehicle insurance is mandatory throughout the contract. Approval can be done entirely online.
retrieved_contexts: Vehicle financing can be arranged with a repayment term of up to 60 months.
The bank was founded in 1985 and currently has more than 500 branches nationwide.
The interest rate for vehicle financing is 1.2% per month for checking account holders.
The weather forecast for the metropolitan area indicates a chance of rain in the coming days.
A minimum down payment of 20% of the vehicle's value is required for financing approval.
Vehicle insurance is optional and can be purchased separately, with no additional cost added to the financing.
Vehicle financing approval can be done entirely online through the bank's app.
The bank's credit card offers a points program and cashback on selected purchases.
Customers can simulate vehicle financing directly on the bank's website, with no commitment.
The savings account yields according to the reference rate plus 0.5% per month.
